name: Hicklebee's Book Fair
description: The Hicklebee's Book Fair is coming to Los Alamitos! We're excited to have a special Family Night on Tuesday, March 24th, from 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM. Please volunteer anytime from Monday to Friday during the week of the book fair.

name: Multicultural Fair
description: This year's Multicultural Fair will take place on Friday April 24th from 4-7pm. A beloved tradition at this school, we once again invite you to share your culture with us, whether it's helping with your country's booth (or starting one if it isn't represented yet!), fashion show, or with a group cultural performance.

name: Hicklebee's Book Fair
description: The Hicklebee's Book Fair is coming to Los Alamitos! Every spring, our PTA is thrilled to host a second book fair to promote summer reading. This year, we're delighted to continue our partnership with our local children's bookstore, Hicklebee's, who will generously provide the books for our fair. We're excited to have a special Family Night on Tuesday, March 24th, from 5:00 PM to 7:00 PM.

name: Pioneer High School Athletics 2026 Crab Feed
description: Come hungry (and thirsty!) to the Pioneer High School Athletics 2026 Crab Feed. It's an all-you-can-eat + all-you-can-drink night that keeps the fun (and the cracking!) going on.

name: Incoming 2025/26 Castillero 6th grade parents
description: Castillero PTA is looking for incoming 6th grade parents to serve on the board. Castillero PTA funds and/ or runs events and programs like school dances, carnival, spirit wear, teacher and staff appreciation, and teacher grants.

name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. We are looking for volunteers who can come in once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday) from 12:45pm - 2:00pm during the school year. Training for new tutors is provided!!

name: 5th Grade Baby Photos Due
description: 5th grade parents — start gathering those adorable baby photos for the 5th Grade Baby Pages! They are due by March 31st! Please send them to your classroom parent yearbook rep and include your child's full name with the photo.

name: Yearbook Photo Deadline
description: We are looking for photos from PTA events this year! If you have photos from the following events and would like them to be shared in the yearbook, please upload to these Google Drive Folders by March 15th: Spirit Days, Dandy Day, Bubblefest, Science-o-rama, and Dances.

name: Nowruz (Iranian New Year) Staff Luncheon
description: Please join us as we treat our staff to a delicious luncheon on Thursday, March 19th, to celebrate the upcoming Iranian New Year and the first day of spring!
